s.t:
Our Social Media Manager, reporting to the Marketing Director, will be a key member of the marketing team and the driving force behind Degy's digital presence. We're looking for a mid-level professional who is forward-thinking, trend-savvy, and passionate about the live entertainment space.

This role is strategy-forward, responsible for setting the vision, roadmap, and execution plans for how Degy shows up across social platforms to grow our audience, engage fans, and amplify our artists and events.

You'll develop and execute comprehensive social media strategies, create and activate campaigns, and produce company-centric content that tells compelling stories. The Social Media Manager will also design and implement data-driven campaigns, track and report on analytics, and make recommendations based on insights to improve performance.

While strategic leadership is the core focus, you'll also roll up your sleeves with caption writing, creative ideation, and occasional hands-on content production (Adobe Suite or Canva). Consistency across all platforms and adaptability to new trends and tools will be key to telling Degy's story effectively.
Opportunities for bonuses based on performance

Qualification into the company's 401k program after required time served
Qualification into the company's pension program after required time served
Paid Time Off (PTO) including vacation and company holidays
General work expenses covered (wifi, computer, travel, supplies)
Optional cell phone plan offered through company phone plan

s.h: Duties will include (but are not limited to)
s.t:
Strategy & Leadership
Develop and own Degy's comprehensive social media strategy, aligning it with brand and business goals.
Define KPIs and reporting standards to evaluate performance and impact on sales.
Make data-driven decisions to improve quality, engagement, and use of communication channels.
Stay current on industry updates, entertainment trends, and new platform features.
Lead with a positive, solutions-focused attitude in a fast-paced environment
Content & Campaign Management
Manage all social media channels across Degy and affiliated companies.
Conceptualize, curate, and create robust and unique posts that meet defined objectives.
Create, update, and manage weekly and monthly content calendars.
Write, curate, and edit copy and scripts with strong storytelling and brand alignment.
Collaborate closely with the marketing and creative teams to execute strategy and campaigns.
Partner with designers, video editors, or external creators to develop visuals, graphics, Reels, and TikToks.
Maintain consistent and regular engagement across all platforms — posting content, monitoring, and replying to comments and messages.
Ensure a consistent brand voice across all posts, campaigns, and platforms.
Analytics & Insights
Pull and analyze performance data using platform-native insights and tools (e.g. Pardot/Salesforce, Agorapulse, Meta Biz Suite, Google Analytics).
Provide regular reports (weekly, monthly, quarterly) with actionable recommendations.
Track content against KPIs and A/B test formats, captions, schedules, and creative.
Make recommendations based on analytics to refine campaigns and further marketing strategy.
Community & Engagement
Monitor and engage with followers through comments, DMs, and mentions to foster relationships.
Establish and manage relationships with influencers, content creators, partners, and Degy roster artists.
Alert Marketing Director and leadership of any online concerns or issues requiring attention.
Respond to sensitive or crisis scenarios in coordination with leadership/PR.
Trends & Paid Media
Create and implement paid social media strategies tailored for each platform.
Manage budgets for boosted posts, paid campaigns, and content tools.
Stay ahead of algorithm changes, entertainment trends, and cultural movements.
Cross-Team Collaboration & Marketing Integration
Partner with the Marketing and Creative Directors to integrate social into larger campaigns.
Support related marketing strategies involving Degy's website, app, ticketing, sponsorship activations, and live events.
Educate internal stakeholders on best practices and new platform features.
Participate in broader company initiatives across Degy's family of entertainment businesses.

Occasionally oversee interns, SkillBridge associates, or other assigned support staff.
Handle off-hours requests as needed for events, live activations, or urgent issues.
Perform other duties as assigned to support Degy's marketing and entertainment initiatives.

We're seeking a mid-level Social Media Manager with at least 3 years of professional experience and a proven track record of managing effective social media platforms. The ideal candidate is hands-on, confident, and outgoing, while also being analytical, organized, process-oriented, and an excellent communicator.
You should bring strong storytelling and copywriting skills, combined with the ability to grow audiences, drive engagement, and run successful campaigns across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube. Proficiency in Canva and CapCut is required, with experience in Adobe Creative Suite a plus.

Familiarity with analytics and platform management tools such as Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and TikTok Business Manager is necessary, and experience with social media management tools is required, with Agorapulse experience a plus. Experience managing paid social budgets and ad campaigns is a plus.
Experience with Office 365 and SharePoint is required, and familiarity with project management software, specifically ClickUp, is a plus.
The ideal candidate is capable of managing multiple projects and shifting deadlines in a fast-paced environment. This role requires adaptability, a willingness to jump in from day one, and the ability to thrive in a remote work setting. Occasional travel to events, conferences, and meetings may be required, along with flexibility to work some nights, weekends, and holidays to support live entertainment.
Must be a United States Citizen and reside in the United States.

Specialized Experience: One year of specialized experience that equipped you with the particular competencies to successfully perform the duties of the position and is directly in or related to this position.

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements including minimum qualifications, and any other regulatory requirements by the cut-off/closing date of the announcement. Combination: Combinations of successfully completed post-high school education and experience may be used to meet total qualification requirements for grade level GS-11 and may be computed by first determining the applicant's total qualifying experience as a percentage of the experience required for the grade level; then determining the applicant's education as a percentage of the education required for the grade level; and then adding the two percentages.

The total percentages must equal at least 100 percent to qualify an applicant for that grade level. Only graduate education in excess of the amount required for the next lower grade level may be used to qualify applicants for positions at grade GS-11.

To be found well-qualified as an ICTAP applicant, individuals need to demonstrate experience including: developing innovative/creative content in response to customer requests or internally generated requirements; identifies target audience and determines best designs for websites; ensures content is appropriate for public distribution; Uses website analytic and diagnostic programs/tools to assess user access patterns and provide improvement recommendations.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

The Senior Social Media Lead plays a key role in delivering high-impact social media activity across a portfolio of client accounts.

Working within the Global Social Media team, this role leads day-to-day execution across content, paid campaigns, community management, and reporting, while driving performance and contributing to campaign strategy and optimization.

This is a hands-on role for someone who knows social media inside out — from platform algorithms and content performance through to paid optimization and audience behavior. This role will be responsible for making campaigns work in practice, while using insight, experience, and judgement to continuously improve results.

Success in this role requires deep platform knowledge, strong content judgement, and a proactive, delivery-focused mindset, alongside the ability to influence clients, elevate quality, and drive performance outcomes.

Duties and Responsibilities: Lead and execute day-to-day delivery of social media activity across assigned global client accounts, owning content, paid campaigns, community engagement, and reporting. Own performance and outcomes across accounts, ensuring activity delivers against agreed objectives and improves over time.

Translate and refine campaign plans into effective execution, identifying opportunities to improve approach and performance. Contribute to the development of social strategies and campaign approaches using performance data, platform insight, and audience understanding.

Act as a trusted client partner, confidently leading conversations, presenting performance and guiding recommendations. Partner with Brand and Client Services teams to align social activity with employer brand positioning, hiring priorities, and campaign objectives.

Plan and manage content calendars, and brief and deliver high-quality content in collaboration with creative teams and clients, including support on content shoots. Create and refine social-first content, including copywriting and reviewing video footage to support short-form video (e.g.

TikTok, Reels), ensuring it aligns with platform best practices and audience expectations. Manage and optimize paid social campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok, ensuring budgets are used effectively and performance targets are met. Analyze performance across organic and paid activity, delivering clear reporting and actionable recommendations.

Connect performance to employer brand and hiring outcomes, using insight to inform future activity. Lead structured testing across content, formats, and targeting to drive continuous improvement. Adapt activity for different markets, recognizing cultural nuance and platform behavior across regions.

Use competitor benchmarking, platform updates, and industry trends to inform optimization and keep activity relevant. Stay current on platform developments and social trends, applying insight to improve delivery and sharing knowledge with internal teams.

Manage community engagement and support employer brand reputation across social and review platforms. Ensure all activity aligns with platform policies, brand guidelines, and governance processes, managing escalation where required.

Support employee advocacy activations and employer brand storytelling through identifying and developing content with employees and stakeholders. Maintain and elevate quality across content, campaigns, and reporting, ensuring best practice is consistently applied.

Manage workload across multiple accounts, ensuring delivery is on time and to a high standard. Provide guidance and support to junior team members, helping improve delivery and capability. Support proposals, pitches, and go-to-market activity by contributing social media expertise and insight. Other duties as assigned.

Tenemos la misión de reducir el 1% de las emisiones globales de gases de efecto invernadero 🌱 🌏. ¡Sé parte de esta historia de impacto!
¿Qué significa ser practicante en Sistema.bio ?
En Sistema.bio buscamos a un/a Practicante de Community Management que quiera sumarse al equipo de Marketing y Comunicación para apoyar en la gestión de redes sociales, creación de contenido y ejecución de iniciativas digitales, contribuyendo al fortalecimiento de nuestra presencia digital y posicionamiento de marca en LATAM.
Como practicante, participarás activamente en la creación de contenido creativo y relevante, redacción de copies, monitoreo de plataformas y apoyo en campañas digitales para redes sociales como Meta (Facebook e Instagram) y TikTok, dentro de un entorno multicultural, colaborativo y con propósito.
¿Qué harás durante tu estancia formativa?
Este programa está diseñado como un espacio de aprendizaje profesional en un entorno real de trabajo, enfocado en el desarrollo de habilidades, observación activa y práctica guiada, sin que esto implique una relación laboral ni responsabilidades propias de un puesto formal.
Apoyar en el monitoreo de redes sociales (Facebook, Instagram y TikTok), identificando interacciones, tendencias, menciones y oportunidades de contenido.
Colaborar en la calendarización y programación de publicaciones alineadas con los objetivos de comunicación y posicionamiento de marca.
Participar en la redacción y adaptación de copies creativos para distintas plataformas digitales, respetando el tono y estilo de Sistema.bio .
Contribuir en la creación de contenido visual y audiovisual para redes sociales, incluyendo reels, videos cortos, stories y piezas digitales, en coordinación con el equipo de diseño.
Apoyar en el desarrollo y crecimiento de la cuenta de TikTok de Sistema.bio , participando en generación de ideas, identificación de tendencias y adaptación de mensajes al formato de la plataforma.
Brindar apoyo en actividades relacionadas con campañas digitales y herramientas como Meta Business Suite y TikTok Ads.
Participar en propuestas creativas para contenidos orgánicos, campañas temáticas y dinámicas digitales.
Colaborar en la elaboración de reportes básicos de métricas e indicadores de desempeño en redes sociales.
Esta es una práctica profesional formativa no remunerada, enfocada en el aprendizaje, la mentoría y la experiencia profesional. No implica una relación laboral ni responsabilidades propias de un puesto formal. La duración de la práctica es de 3 a 6 meses, de acuerdo con los requisitos de cada institución educativa para la liberación de prácticas profesionales.

As a Paid Social Senior Manager, you’ll lead the strategic direction, optimization approach, and performance growth for a portfolio of primarily eCommerce and DTC clients. You’ll oversee paid social programs across platforms like Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit, Snapchat, and LinkedIn - helping clients scale revenue, improve efficiency, and evolve acquisition strategies through structured testing, thoughtful optimization, and data-informed decision making.
While this role remains highly hands-on and performance-focused, you’ll also be expected to think more holistically about the customer journey - understanding how prospecting, retargeting, creative strategy, attribution, and lifecycle marketing efforts work together to support broader business goals.
As a senior strategic contributor, you’ll help communicate performance insights, testing learnings, and optimization recommendations that support smarter investment decisions and long-term account growth.

s.h: What your day-to-day will look like
s.t:
Campaign Strategy & Execution
Leading paid social strategy across a portfolio of primarily eCommerce and DTC accounts
Building and managing full-funnel paid social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit, Snapchat, and LinkedIn
Structuring campaign architectures with strong emphasis on performance, scalability, and conversion outcomes
Managing budgets, pacing, bid strategies, audience segmentation, and spend allocation decisions across funnel stages
Identifying growth opportunities and optimization priorities based on account performance and business goals
Staying informed on platform updates, beta products, and evolving paid social best practices
Performance Optimization & Testing
Monitoring performance daily and proactively optimizing campaigns based on KPIs such as ROAS, CPA, CAC, CVR, MER, and revenue
Leading structured A/B testing initiatives across creative, audiences, placements, bidding strategies, and landing page experiences
Developing optimization plans designed to improve efficiency, scalability, and long-term account performance
Translating performance trends into actionable testing hypotheses and strategic recommendations
Documenting testing learnings and helping identify repeatable best practices across accounts
Measurement & Analytics
Analyzing platform data, third-party analytics, and attribution tools to evaluate campaign performance and guide optimization decisions
Supporting measurement best practices including tracking validation, attribution alignment, CAPI implementation, and campaign tagging
Translating performance data into actionable insights and clear next-step recommendations for clients and internal teams
Helping clients understand how paid social contributes across broader acquisition and conversion efforts
Contributing to performance analysis tied to incrementality thinking, attribution models, and broader media efficiency conversations
Identifying opportunities to improve reporting clarity, performance interpretation, and measurement consistency
Creative & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partnering closely with creative teams to inform and iterate on social-first, performance-driven creative concepts
Providing strategic creative feedback rooted in performance insights, audience behavior, messaging trends, and platform-native best practices
Collaborating with Client Strategy, SEO, CRO, Analytics, and broader Paid Media teams on integrated campaign initiatives
Helping align paid social efforts with broader lifecycle, retention, and customer acquisition strategies
Supporting cross-functional planning initiatives that connect paid social to broader business and marketing goals
Client Communication & Account Ownership
Owning performance outcomes across assigned accounts, including optimization direction, strategic recommendations, and execution quality
Leading client calls, performance discussions, and campaign reviews as a trusted day-to-day strategic lead
Communicating testing rationales, optimization priorities, and performance insights in a clear and business-oriented way
Preparing reporting insights, strategic recommendations, and testing updates for both internal teams and client stakeholders
Managing multiple client accounts simultaneously with strong organization and prioritization
Building strong client trust through proactive communication, accountability, strategic thinking, and consistent delivery of high-quality work

s.h: Was wir dir bieten - Unsere Benefits
s.t:
Wir fördern Chancengleichheit und schätzen Vielfalt. Wir verpflichten uns, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitende zu schaffen.
yfood wächst international: Obwohl Deutschland unsers „Home Base“ ist, haben wir mit unseren internationalen Märkten ein dynamisches und buntes Umfeld geschaffen, in dem viele spannende Themen auf Dich warten.
Agilität ist uns wichtig . Daher arbeiten wir in einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell und bieten dir die Möglichkeit mit Workation aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten.
Urlaub ist wichtig. Daher erhältst du bei uns 30 Tage bezahlten Urlaub im Jahr.
yfood hält dich fit. Mit einer subventionierten Mitgliedschaft bei EGYM-Wellpass kannst du dir für nur 29€ im Monat Gutes tun. Dazu bieten wir im Rahmen unseres Gesundheitsmanagements & Healthy@yfood Workshops und Aktionen (z.B. Yoga, Breathwork, Soccer, Pickleball) an.
Weg vom Fleck. Wir steuern 30€ zu deinem ÖPNV-Ticket bei und bieten dir über JobRad die Möglichkeit, vergünstigt ein Fahrrad zu leasen.
Trainiere deine Geschmacksnerven. Bei uns ist jeder der Lust hat Teil unseres Sensory-Teams. Probiere also neue Produkte, Sorten oder Geschmäcker vor allen anderen. Ansonsten gibt es so viel yfood wie du tragen kannst, natürlich auch für dich gratis.
Als Start-Up hat man oft mit Klischees zu kämpfen. Manche sind aber auch wahr. Daher gibt es bei uns natürlich auch einen Obstkorb, deinen gratis Koffein-Kick oder das stille Wässerchen.
Come as you are . Ob im Anzug oder Einhorn-Onesie. Einen Dresscode kennen wir nicht.

Katharina Bauer
Senior Talent Acquisition Manager

## Description ##
## Where passion meets opportunity ##
The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!
## Your Purpose ##
Bring the MSC Cruises experience to life across our global social channels.
As a freelance Social Media Specialist, you will support our Global Social Media team in developing relevant content, managing editorial calendars and building meaningful interactions with our audiences. Combining creative judgement with performance insights, you will turn brand priorities and emerging trends into content that connects with audiences across platforms and markets.
You will collaborate closely with our social media team, content creators and editor, taking ownership of agreed deliverables from initial idea through publication and performance review.
**This is an external freelance opportunity under a services agreement. You must have a registered business.**

**Content and editorial planning**
* Develop and manage editorial calendars across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Broadcast Channels, Threads and Pinterest.
* Schedule and publish approximately 20 posts per primary channel per month, coordinating always-on content, campaigns, press releases and toolkits.
* Write engaging, platform-specific captions and apply SEO and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) principles to improve content discoverability.
* Contribute fresh concepts to every editorial plan and support creator briefs for key brand moments, including new ship launches and onboard shoots.
* Coordinate with MSC content creators and the editor to prepare content for publication.
* Manage market folders in Meta Business Suite, enabling local teams to access and publish global content.
**Reactive content and innovation**
* Identify content opportunities through audience behaviour, content gap analysis, search insights and historical performance.
* Monitor trending formats, sounds and cultural moments, translating relevant opportunities into timely, brand-appropriate proposals.
* Coordinate reactive content using existing brand assets and stock material, and support the finalisation of creator-produced content.
* Test new formats and creative approaches, define hypotheses and assess results.
* Monitor platform developments and recommend relevant features and content experiments.
**Performance and reporting**
* Analyse performance weekly across all active platforms, including search queries and engagement patterns, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Deliver ad hoc analysis on specific content initiatives, including CGI, AI-generated content and partnership campaigns.
* Prepare quarterly reporting covering competitor benchmarking and labelling compliance.
**Community and engagement**
* Manage community interactions across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and YouTube Shorts.
* Moderate comments within 30 minutes of publication for active posts, within agreed coverage arrangements.
* Identify and engage in relevant conversations on third-party channels daily, and prepare a monthly recap of standout interactions.
* Review the CreatorIQ inbox to identify influencer mentions and select user-generated content, supporting up to 150 UGC assets per year.
* Support crisis monitoring by tracking emerging topics, recurring themes and audience reactions, escalating issues to the appropriate team.
**Additional content support**
* Support branding initiatives, competition asset coordination and Instagram content localisation for markets.
* Maintain and organise YouTube playlists.
* Produce blog content supporting the Pinterest SEO strategy.
## Your Journey so far ##
* Proven experience in social media management, editorial planning and community engagement for a brand or agency.
* Strong English copywriting skills and the ability to adapt content to different platforms, audiences and brand priorities.
* A critical eye for social content, with a clear understanding of what makes an idea relevant and effective for a brand.
* Confidence interpreting performance data and using insights to improve content, engagement and discoverability.
* Hands-on familiarity with Creator Studio, Emplifi and YouTube Studio, alongside Meta Business Suite.
* Familiarity with Claude (Anthropic), a basic understanding of SEMrush, and the ability to work with CreatorIQ for influencer mentions and UGC selection.
* Strong organisation, attention to detail and ownership of deliverables, with the ability to coordinate multiple content streams and respond to time-sensitive opportunities.
* Sound judgement when moderating conversations and handling sensitive topics.
* **A registered business or company able to enter into a services agreement and issue invoices.**
## Your Essentials ##
You will work with the MSC Cruises Global Social Media team as an independent service provider. Fees, duration, deliverables and working arrangements will be agreed before the assignment begins.
Depending on project, campaign and publishing requirements, service coverage may include weekends and public holidays within the Monday-Sunday, 09:00-20:00 publishing window. Specific availability and response arrangements will be agreed as part of the scope of services.
## Our commitment ##
We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.
Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

# Community Manager #
**Location:** Lausanne, Switzerland
**Work model:** Onsite / Full time
**Contract type / duration:** Permanent
**Start date:** January 1, 2027
**Deadline for applications**: October 7, 2026
**Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation**
As a Community Manager at Nestlé Research, your mission is to strengthen employee engagement, belonging, and connection across Nestlé Research and the wider Research and Development community. You-ll make a difference by collaborating closely with employees, leaders, sites, functions, and communities.
**How you-ll make an impact as a** **Community Manager**
* Strengthening employee engagement and belonging through meaningful initiatives that connect people across sites and communities.
* Creating engaging communication moments, campaigns, events, and digital content that inspire participation and shared purpose.
* Listening to employees and turning community insights (e.g. through surveys) into relevant actions that improve the employee experience.
* Building trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels to connect people needs with business priorities.
* Facilitating conversations and translating complex topics into clear, accessible messages that build understanding and momentum.
* Delivering initiatives with structure, creativity, and quality to create visible impact for employees and the organization.
**What will make you successful**
* Bringing strong experience in employee engagement, internal communications, community management, events, or related community-building fields.
* Applying creativity, storytelling, and digital communication skills to design engaging formats, campaigns, and content.
* Using strong project management and organizational skills to deliver several initiatives in parallel with quality and impact.
* Collaborating confidently with diverse stakeholders, including leaders, while influencing with diplomacy and a solution-oriented mindset.
* Communicating fluently in English; working proficiency in French is a strong asset.
* Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.
**At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do**
Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:
* Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

* Learning and development opportunities to grow your career
* Performance based bonus
* Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program
* Strong employer contribution to your pension plan
* Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions
* Attractive employee discounts across various products and services
**What to expect from our hiring process**
We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.
The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and final discussions and offer. Depending on the role, a video assessment may be included.We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.
*Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.*

Major League Hacking (MLH) is looking for someone to join our growing team in the US as a Hackathon Community Manager. Every year, MLH works with thousands of student and faculty event organizers around the world to organize weekend-long invention competitions called hackathons.

As a Hackathon Community Manager, you’ll be responsible for working with those organizers to make their hackathons successful. This is a great role for an aspiring developer advocate or someone who wants to learn the ins and outs of managing a large technical community.

Recruit, vet, and onboard new hackathon organizers. You’ll need to conduct interviews with potential new hackathon organizers, communicate the value that MLH brings to their event, and onboard them into our community of organizers.
Mentor & support hackathon organizers. You’ll work closely with our community of event organizers to help them successfully plan hackathons. You’ll meet with them individually and in groups to share best practices, provide feedback, and guide them to achieving their goals.
Create hackathon planning tools & resources. You’ll be responsible for creating content and resources to make organizing a successful hackathon as simple as possible.
Build & maintain relationships with organizers in our community. We work with hackathon organizers across many years. You’ll be responsible for creating a strong connection between organizers and MLH and nurturing that relationship over time.
Represent MLH at hackathons. You’ll travel to a number of hackathons throughout the year to represent MLH and meet the event organizers you’ve been working with in person. At these events, you’ll also have the opportunity to do hands-on customer development research and mentor other MLH event staff.
Roll out & track the success of new initiatives. You’ll need to work closely with other teams inside MLH to launch new initiatives at our hackathons. You’ll also need to communicate with our organizer community around these new initiatives and changes to our product.
Find new ways for MLH to empower hackers. We are always on the lookout for new ways that we can bring value to the hackers who participate in MLH hackathons. You’ll source new, interesting opportunities through your close interactions with our community and partner with internal and external stakeholders to bring them to life.
Equity options

Unlimited PTO
Travel opportunities

$$67,500 - $75,000
About MLH
Major League Hacking 's (MLH) mission is to empower hackers. Each year over 135,000 young technologists and innovators around the world attend MLH events and join our community. Our events provide a self-driven environment where community members learn from each other outside the confines of traditional academia. The MLH team grew out of this movement and is dedicated to making it accessible to the entire world.
We’re a team of 20 full-time people primarily based in Manhattan with team members in Seattle, London, and India.
Our co-founders, Swift and Jon, were recognized for their work in education by Forbes in the 2017 30 Under 30 list.
We work with some of the top technology brands like Dell, Oculus, and Amazon to help them reach our community and get the latest and greatest tools into their hands.
We have a group of world-class investors including General Catalyst, Alexis Ohanian (Reddit), Jeff Lawson (Twilio), and Sundance DiGiovanni (Major League Gaming).
We are a mission driven B Corp, committed to responsibly serving the world and our community.
The hacker movement is taking off! Since we started in 2013, we’ve powered more than 1,000 weekend-long invention marathons (called hackathons).

Experience organizing events. Bonus points if those events were hackathons.
Experience in the student hacker community.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Willingness to travel and occasionally work weekends.

s.h: You’re passionate about technical education and communities.
s.t:
If you’ve found yourself excited thinking about this role, even if you don’t quite meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Hacking is all about figuring out different solutions to problems, and showing how your experience might serve as a substitute for our requirements might be your first hack with us.
We serve a diverse community and perspectives of women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ people, and those with backgrounds typically not served by technology help us serve our community more deeply. We strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other marginalized communities.
We're a fully remote company, but prefer to hire near other team members so you can get together with them more easily. In the US of our team is in the New York City Area.

Tissot has been growing and developing its tradition of innovation since 1853. From the early days to the present, in its home in Le Locle in the Swiss Jura Mountains, Tissot has translated craftsmanship and precision into stylish timepieces now sold in over 160 countries around the world.

We are hiring our next **Social Media Specialist,** based in Le Locle to join the International Digital Marketing team at Tissot Headquarters !
## Job description ##

* Support influencer and creator initiatives, from profile identification to content coordination and amplification.

* Collaborate with Customer Care to monitor comments, direct messages and community feedback.
* Monitor social media trends, platform developments and emerging formats to identify new opportunities.
* Analyze social media account performances with proactive suggestions and improvements.
* Support digital marketing projects and initiatives.
## Profile ##
* Degree in Marketing, Communication, Media or a related field.
* First significant professional experience in social media or digital marketing is required, preferably within the luxury, lifestyle or consumer goods industry.

* Excellent writing and communication skills, with the ability to adapt content and tone of voice to different platforms and audiences.
* Strong understanding of Meta, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn, with hands-on experience managing social media accounts and content.
* Creative mindset with a strong interest in content, storytelling and social media trends.
* Tech-savvy and comfortable working with digital platforms and tools.
* Strong analytical, organizational, planning and time-management skills.
* Proactive, self-motivated and able to work independently while being a strong team player.
* Entrepreneurial mindset, with the curiosity and initiative to identify new opportunities and continuously improve social media activities.

Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.
